change.summary: Disable Beachparty message bottles and install the newer Streams planner with compatible biome search.

modifiers.before: Natural spawns, native merchant availability and held-item use could produce a structure map.
modifiers.after: Disable natural spawning, NPC trade and held-item use for the exact bottle ID. Existing placed blocks have no open action.
2.17.1 properties, MEDIUM rivers and lakes, legacy shaping for old-world continuity, and JEM biome exclusions.
BiomeSpy 1.3.3 biome search with Structurify's structure search retained when both mods are loaded.

cause.owner: Beachparty, Item Obliterator, JEM Economy, Streams Reflowing and JEM Compat

rationale.purpose: Remove the bottle's structure-search trigger and reduce generation work without dropping rivers, lakes or structure placement rules.
rationale.decision_source: The user requested bottle removal, retained Streams Reflowing and approved the performance work.
rationale.implementation_choices: Use native bottle spawner and interaction configuration, the existing trade owner, a matching upstream Streams release and an exact-version MixinSquared gate for the conflicting locator. Correct retired module inventory so active artifacts can build.

introduced.summary: Disable the message bottle and migrate Streams and biome search.

history.summary: Retire the legacy Streams configs and replace the pinned artifact.

relations: Beachparty spawner -> existing bottle item -> native structure map search
JEM Economy and Item Obliterator -> exact bottle acquisition and use denial
Streams Reflowing -> waterway terrain, vegetation and currents
notes: 2.17.1 adds Flow Wand and Carve Wand brush variants. JEM removes the exact Carve Wand survival recipe pending verification of terrain editing permissions.
No offline save scan or rewrite is required.
unresolved: Manual acceptance and before/after exploration latency are pending.
